name: smwmusic-hooded-snes-originals-brawlin-on-the-streets
title: Hooded SNES Originals - Brawlin' On The Streets 👊
description:
A boss variation of the original song I made before this one, Groovin' Through The Streets. Leaned in more towards JRPG battle themes for this bad boy, especially with battle & boss themes from SNES Final Fantasy and Mega Man Battle Network.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," & Thunder SFX are disabled.
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ Death sound is gonna sound weird (@0 replaces @9 to save on space).

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. F Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. E Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. F# Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ4. G Minor (Custom Pitch 3)

Also, there's an option to change compatibility to either support the Yoshi SFX or P-Switch Music:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Yoshi SFX, but Disables P-Switch Music [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Enables P-Switch Music, but Disables Yoshi SFX
